name: Starlink Group 15-25
slot_a_text: B1088 has flown 19 times in 22 months. The mix: fourteen Starlink, two NROL, one Transporter, and two others. At its fastest it was back on the pad in 9 days.
slot_b_text: SpaceX's 118th launch of the year, 737th all time. Their year has run at a launch every other day. Falcon 9 is on a 339-flight success streak.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
